text:
The purpose of this meeting is to review operational readiness and shared responsibilities for companion animal travel services across Aurelia Skyways.  

Attendees were Khalil Garcia, Sofia Alvarez, and Toby.  

The coordinator opened with a reminder that the Companion Animal Travel Desk must coordinate continuity from acceptance through onboard care, emphasizing careful carrier handling by the ground team when transferring carriers between services. Staff confirmed that the desk ledger continues to be updated at each handoff, with service changes recorded clearly so that care plans follow the animal without interruption. The coordinator reiterated that each journey is treated as a shared responsibility among desk staff, ground team members, and onboard personnel, and that species-specific comfort requirements remain part of every preparation step. <<FACT F034>> Staff reviewed how the desk ledger references comfort notes, including temperament considerations, to support a consistent plan during transfers and stabilization periods.  

Next, the discussion shifted to onboard handling for Starling flights, focusing on continuity of supervision and calm procedures after boarding. <<FACT F051>> Staff agreed to ensure that any relevant species and temperament notes from the care plan are available at the point of boarding. The senior coordinator also directed that carrier placement and access remain consistent with the care plan, and that any observed stress signals be logged immediately to guide follow-on decisions.  

Finally, staff reviewed a standard communication flow for updates between ground and onboard teams, including clear handover language and prompt ledger entries. Sofia Alvarez reported on traveler expectations, and Khalil Garcia confirmed that he can provide calm reinforcement guidance to staff when requested. Toby remained a reference point for confirming that comfort procedures are followed exactly.  

The meeting concluded with agreed next steps for ledger updates and onboard continuity across upcoming services.  

Meeting ended.
